## Behavior

Describe the problem and resulting behavior. Link the issue with Closes #number.

## Validation

List checks actually performed, their outcomes, and material limitations.
For native changes, include source application/OS compatibility results.
For UI changes, attach light/dark screenshots and record keyboard/zoom checks.

## Contributor checklist

- [ ] Read AGENTS.md and CONTRIBUTING.md.
- [ ] Ran npm run check, or documented the concrete blocker.
- [ ] Updated relevant documentation, decisions, branding, and notices.
- [ ] Preserved sense-specific content and source/license information.
- [ ] Included no private selections, credentials, or unrelated changes.
